generic.Defined scope/population: All in-force assumed treaties held in the reinsurance administration system at the accumulation as-of date
generic.In-scope period: The current accumulation as-of date and the treaty year in force on that date
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every assumed treaty row carries peril, CRESTA zone, territory code and sum insured
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Aggregated sums insured equal the in-force treaty register control total for the as-of date
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract query, run timestamp and record count stored in the accumulation working paper
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Treaties with missing or defaulted geocoding listed with a follow-up owner and outcome
generic.Test population: All assumed treaty rows in the accumulation extract for the as-of date
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero rows with null peril or null zone code and nil variance to the treaty register total
generic.Exception handling path: Ungeocoded or unmapped treaties routed to the Retrocession Manager for manual mapping
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Extract ties to the register and every row maps to a peril, zone and territory code
generic.Evidence location: Accumulation working paper holding the extract query, record count and reconciliation

steps.title: Extract in-force assumed treaties from the reinsurance administration system at the as-of date
sop: Set the as-of date agreed for this accumulation cycle
Run the in-force assumed treaty extract filtered to that date
Record the query text and the returned record count
Done when the extract file is produced with its record count noted
verify: Check the extract header shows the intended as-of date
Check the record count is written into the working paper
Pass when the extract exists for the correct as-of date with a recorded count

steps.title: Load the treaty extract into the enterprise data warehouse accumulation staging area
sop: Load the extract into the staging table for the accumulation cycle
Confirm the loaded row count equals the extract row count
Reject and re-load if any row fails the load validation
Done when staged rows equal extracted rows with no load rejects
verify: Compare staged row count to the source extract count
Review the load reject log for the run
Pass when staged and extracted counts match and the reject log is empty

steps.title: Map each assumed treaty to peril, CRESTA zone and territory code in the data warehouse
sop: Join the staged treaties to the peril and CRESTA zone reference tables
Apply the territory code mapping for each cedant location
List rows that fail to map for manual assignment
Done when every staged treaty carries a peril, zone and territory value
verify: Query the staged set for null peril or null zone code
Confirm the unmapped list is empty or fully assigned
Pass when no staged treaty row holds a null peril or zone code

steps.title: Flag treaties with missing or defaulted exposure geocoding in the data warehouse exception view
sop: Identify treaties carrying default or centroid geocodes rather than real locations
Record each flagged treaty with its cedant and the reason for the default
Assign a follow-up owner and target date to each flagged treaty
Done when every geocoding exception is logged with an owner
verify: Check each flagged treaty has an owner and a target date
Check no defaulted geocode is left off the exception view
Pass when all geocoding exceptions are logged with an owner and date

steps.title: Reconcile extracted assumed sums insured to the treaty register control report
sop: Run the treaty register control report for the same as-of date
Compare total sums insured from the extract to the control total
Investigate and explain any difference before proceeding
Done when the extract total agrees to the register control total
verify: Recompute the difference between extract and control totals
Read the explanation for any residual difference
Pass when the extract total agrees to the register total or the difference is explained

steps.title: Aggregate exposures by peril, geography and cedant in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Import the mapped exposure set into the actuarial modeling platform
Aggregate sums insured by peril, by CRESTA zone and by cedant
Confirm the aggregate total equals the input exposure total
Done when the three aggregation views are produced and balance to input
verify: Sum each aggregation view and compare to the input total
Spot check one cedant total back to the source extract
Pass when every aggregation view sums back to the loaded exposure total

steps.title: File the extract query, counts and aggregations in the accumulation working paper
sop: Attach the extract query, record count and reconciliation to the working paper
Attach the aggregation output with the model run reference
Note the geocoding exceptions carried into the run as a data limitation
Done when the working paper is complete and dated for the cycle
verify: Open the working paper and confirm all attachments are present
Confirm the data limitation note is recorded
Pass when the dated working paper holds the extract, reconciliation and aggregations

generic.Defined scope/population: All groups of assumed contracts exposed to peak perils within the IFRS-17 measurement model
generic.In-scope period: The current IFRS-17 reporting period and its contract service margin roll-forward
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each contract group carries a CSM balance, loss component and peak-peril exposure tag
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Opening plus movements equals closing CSM for every group in the sensitivity run
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Model version, run date and scenario definition stored with the CSM volatility memo
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Groups excluded from the sensitivity run listed with the reason for exclusion
generic.Test population: All peak-peril exposed contract groups in the current reporting period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Sensitivity runs exist at the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 return periods with a recorded model version
generic.Exception handling path: Unexplained CSM movements referred to the Reinsurance Accountant before the memo is issued
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: CSM impact is split between onerous and profitable groups and shown gross and net of retro
generic.Evidence location: CSM volatility memo with the attached model run log for the reporting period

steps.title: Extract the current CSM and loss component balances by contract group from the data warehouse
sop: Pull the closing CSM and loss component per group of assumed contracts
Confirm the balances agree to the ledger IFRS-17 subledger
Tag each group with its peak-peril exposure flag
Done when tagged balances are extracted and agree to the subledger
verify: Compare extracted CSM totals to the subledger balance
Confirm every extracted group carries a peril tag
Pass when extracted balances agree to the subledger and all groups are tagged

steps.title: Define the peak-peril event scenarios to be run in the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Select the 1-in-100 and 1-in-250 peak-peril events from the current event set
Document the perils, territories and event severities used
Record the model version and event set reference
Done when the scenario definitions are recorded with the model version
verify: Read the scenario definition against the current approved event set
Confirm the model version is recorded
Pass when both return-period scenarios are defined with a recorded model version

steps.title: Run the CSM roll-forward with and without the peak-peril event in the actuarial platform
sop: Run the base CSM roll-forward for the period
Re-run with each peak-peril event applied to the exposed groups
Confirm opening plus movements equals closing CSM in every run
Done when base and stressed roll-forwards are complete and internally balanced
verify: Check the roll-forward balances for each run
Compare base run closing CSM to the extracted subledger balance
Pass when every roll-forward balances and the base run ties to the subledger

steps.title: Split the CSM impact between onerous and profitable groups in Microsoft Excel
sop: Classify each affected group as onerous or profitable at the reporting date
Allocate the modelled CSM impact to each classification
Quantify the loss component release triggered on each affected cohort
Done when the impact split and loss component release are quantified
verify: Confirm every affected group appears in exactly one classification
Recompute the total split back to the modelled impact
Pass when the split totals equal the modelled CSM impact

steps.title: Compare CSM volatility gross and net of the current retro programme in Excel
sop: Apply the in-force retro recoveries to each stressed scenario
Recompute the CSM impact after retro recovery
Show gross and net volatility side by side by return period
Done when the gross and net comparison exhibit is produced
verify: Check the net impact is never larger than the gross impact
Confirm both return periods appear in the exhibit
Pass when gross and net CSM volatility are shown for both return periods

steps.title: Circulate the CSM volatility memo to Group Finance from the modelling platform outputs
sop: Draft the memo covering scenarios, impacts, splits and the retro effect
Attach the model run log and the scenario definitions
Send the memo to Group Finance ahead of the reporting close
Done when the memo is issued before the close deadline
verify: Check the issue date against the reporting close deadline
Confirm the model version appears in the issued memo
Pass when the dated memo is issued before close with the model version stated

generic.Defined scope/population: The gross event loss table for the assumed book together with every in-force inuring retro layer

steps.title: Load the in-force retro layer terms into the actuarial modeling platform
sop: Extract attachment, limit, share and reinstatement terms for every in-force layer
Load the layer set into the modelling platform netting module
Confirm the loaded terms match the executed slips
Done when every in-force layer is loaded and matches its slip
verify: Compare a sample of loaded layers to the executed slips
Confirm the layer count equals the in-force programme count

steps.title: Apply occurrence and aggregate retro layers to the gross event loss table in the actuarial platform

verify: Check the inuring sequence applied in the run log

steps.title: Net down for reinstatement premium payable on cat layers in the actuarial platform
sop: Calculate reinstatement premium triggered by each modelled recovery
Deduct the reinstatement premium from the modelled recovery

verify: Recompute reinstatement premium for one layer by hand

steps.title: Produce net PML at the 1-in-50 to 1-in-500 return periods by peril in the actuarial platform
sop: Compute net PML at 1-in-50, 1-in-100, 1-in-250 and 1-in-500 by peril
Produce results on both occurrence and aggregate bases
Record the model run reference for the output
Done when net PML is produced at all four return periods by peril
verify: Check all four return periods are present for every modelled peril
Confirm the run reference is recorded on the output
Pass when net PML exists at all four return periods for every peril

steps.title: Reconcile ceded amounts to modelled retro recoveries by layer in Microsoft Excel
sop: Sum ceded amounts by layer from the netting output
Compare each layer total to the contractual limit and reinstatements available
Investigate any layer where ceded exceeds the available limit
Done when every layer ceded amount sits within its contractual limit
verify: Recompute the ceded total for the largest layer
Check no layer exceeds limit times reinstatements available

steps.title: Build the gross, ceded and net PML comparison exhibit in Microsoft Excel
sop: Lay out gross, ceded and net PML side by side by peril and return period
Confirm gross less ceded equals net in every cell
File the exhibit with the model run reference and date
Done when the balanced exhibit is filed with its run reference
verify: Test the gross less ceded equals net identity across the exhibit
Confirm the run reference and date appear on the exhibit
Pass when the identity holds in every cell and the run reference is shown

steps.title: Flag perils above 90% of tolerance as amber early warnings in the Power BI view

steps.title: Record the cause and proposed mitigating retro action for each breach in Excel

verify: Check each breach row holds a cause and a named action owner

steps.title: Obtain Head of Reinsurance sign-off on the tolerance comparison before committee
sop: Review the comparison against the appetite statement and model output

Sign and date the comparison once satisfied

verify: Confirm the sign-off names the approver and the date

steps.title: Set the earnings-volatility and capital-relief objectives in the objectives workbook

steps.title: Set the maximum retro spend as a percentage of assumed premium in Excel
